newsitem.title: UK: Turkey awards 75,000 T gas oil in tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkey awards 75,000 T gas oil in tender - trade.

text.p: Turkey has bought 75,000 tonnes of gas oil for delivery in August at premiums of $7.99 and $10.88 above fob Med mean quotes, traders said on Friday.

State oil company Tupras awarded Temportrade two 25,000 tonne cargoes of 0.7 percent sulphur gas oil at fob Med mean +$10.88 for delivery in the second decade of August, with one going to Iskanderun and the other to Gulf of Izmit, the traders said.
Tupras awarded Glencore a 25,000 tonne cargo of 0.2 percent sulphur gas oil at fob Med mean +$7.99 for prompt delivery to Gulf of Izmit, they said.
